zh.title: 華航連 11 年獲 APEX 全球五星航空　首奪大中華區最佳座椅舒適度
zh.summary: 華航獲列 2027 年度 APEX 全球五星航空，首奪大中華區最佳座椅舒適度。華航即將引進的波音 787 也已公布三艙等座椅設計。
body: 國際航空乘客體驗協會（APEX）11 月 19 日在新加坡濱海灣金沙會展中心公布 2027 年度亞洲與南太平洋區域獎項，中華航空摘下大中華區最佳座椅舒適度。華航翌日證實，這是它首度拿下這項座椅獎，也是連續第 11 年獲列 APEX 全球五星航空。
全球五星航空著重旅客對整趟航程的整體評分，座椅舒適度則是區域分項。APEX 與 SAP Concur 旗下的 TripIt 合作蒐集搭乘回饋，公布的本屆資料涵蓋 722 家航空公司、逾百萬筆經驗證的航班評分。2027 是獎項年度，反映的是 2026 年完成的評選週期。
獲獎之際，華航正準備引進波音 787。華航在 6 月的 COMPUTEX 首度公開 787 豪華經濟艙座椅，預計配置 28 席，採 2-3-2 排列。座椅設有六向可調頭枕，餐桌整合手機與平板支架，個人娛樂螢幕為 15.6 吋 4K，並支援藍牙耳機。
同一批 787 的豪華商務艙將採獨立包廂，經濟艙則配備多功能收納袋與 13.3 吋 4K 螢幕。這些是華航已公布的新機規格。APEX 公開的區域獎結果以航空公司為單位，沒有公布個別機型或艙等的評分。
客艙更新也延伸到餐飲。華航在洛杉磯出發的航線與當地台灣餐廳 WENWEN 合作，新加坡返台航線則與瓊榮記海鮮餐館（KEK Seafood）合作。這些菜單依出發地安排，與新機座椅是分開推出的服務。

en.title: China Airlines earns 11th straight APEX Five Star rating and first regional seat comfort award
en.summary: China Airlines earned 2027 APEX Five Star Global Airline recognition and its first Best Seat Comfort award for Greater China as it prepares to introduce its Boeing 787 cabins.
body: The Airline Passenger Experience Association (APEX) announced its 2027 Asia and South Pacific regional awards at Singapore’s Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention Centre on November 19. China Airlines won Best Seat Comfort in Greater China. The carrier confirmed the following day that it was its first win in the category and its 11th consecutive APEX Five Star Global Airline recognition.

The Five Star rating reflects passengers’ overall flight experience, while seat comfort is a separate regional category. APEX collected passenger feedback through TripIt by SAP Concur. This year’s programme drew on more than one million verified flight ratings covering 722 airlines. The 2027 designation follows the evaluation cycle completed in 2026.

China Airlines is also preparing to introduce its Boeing 787 fleet. It unveiled the 787 premium economy seat at COMPUTEX in June and plans to fit 28 seats in a 2-3-2 layout. The seat features a six-way adjustable headrest, a tray table with a phone and tablet holder, and a 15.6-inch 4K entertainment screen with Bluetooth headphone pairing.

The new 787s will also have individual suites in premium business class and multifunction storage pockets and 13.3-inch 4K screens in economy. These are specifications for the upcoming aircraft. APEX published the regional award at airline level, without individual aircraft or cabin scores.

The carrier has been tailoring its onboard menus to departure markets. It has partnered with Taiwanese restaurant WENWEN on flights departing Los Angeles and with KEK Seafood on flights from Singapore to Taiwan. Those menus are separate from the 787 cabin rollout.

zh.title: Rostec宣佈向俄羅斯航太軍交付新一批Su-57戰機
zh.summary: Rostec宣佈交付Su-57戰機；UAC於2026年第三次公佈交機，數量未公開
body: Rostec表示，已向俄羅斯航太軍交付另一批Sukhoi Su-57第五代戰鬥機。該公司是俄羅斯United Aircraft Corporation（UAC）的母公司。
這是UAC在2026年公開宣佈的第三次Su-57交付。公司沒有說明這批交付了多少架戰機；在前兩次公佈交機時，也沒有揭露各批的數量。
Rostec指出，俄羅斯國防部的飛行員曾以多種飛行模式，對這批戰機進行評估。公司並稱，戰機配備升級的機載系統與武器，包括其所稱的「低可偵測性巡弋飛彈」。

en.title: Rostec announces another Su-57 fighter delivery to the Russian Aerospace Forces
en.summary: Rostec announces another Su-57 delivery; UAC has publicized three in 2026 without disclosing quantities.
body: Rostec said it had delivered another batch of Sukhoi Su-57 fifth-generation fighters to the Russian Aerospace Forces. Rostec is the parent company of Russia’s United Aircraft Corporation (UAC).

The announcement marks the third Su-57 delivery UAC has publicly announced in 2026. The company did not say how many fighters were handed over in the latest batch; it did not disclose the numbers for the previous two batches either.

Rostec said Russian Ministry of Defense pilots evaluated the fighters in various flight modes. The company also said the aircraft were equipped with upgraded onboard systems and weapons, including what it described as “low-observable cruise missiles”.

zh.title: 聯合航空713架飛機已裝 Starlink 支線機佔352架
zh.summary: 聯合航空11月19日公布，已有713架飛機裝設 Starlink，約佔機隊47%。公司仍以2027年底完成全機隊安裝為目標。
body: 聯合航空11月19日更新機上網路進度，已為713架飛機安裝 Starlink，約佔機隊47%。其中有352架支線客機、353架窄體客機和8架寬體客機。
按機型來看，追蹤頁所列100架 CRJ-550 和252架 E175 均已完成安裝。窄體機隊中，波音737有211架、737 MAX 有71架，空中巴士 A321 另有71架完成安裝。
聯合航空仍以2027年底完成全機隊安裝為目標。旅客可在出發前3天內，用航班編號和日期在聯航網站查詢是否提供 Starlink。

en.title: United installs Starlink on 713 aircraft, including 352 regional jets
en.summary: United’s November 19 update puts Starlink installation at 47% of its fleet. The airline still targets completion by the end of 2027.
body: United Airlines reported Starlink installations on 713 aircraft in its November 19 update, covering 47% of the fleet. The total comprised 352 regional aircraft, 353 narrowbodies and eight widebodies.
United’s tracker lists all 100 CRJ-550s and all 252 E175s as equipped. Among narrowbodies, it shows 211 Boeing 737s, 71 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft and 71 Airbus A321s with installations completed.
United is still targeting the end of 2027 for fleetwide installation. Passengers can use its tracker to look up availability by flight number and date up to three days before departure.

zh.title: 泰雷茲以三地據點服務亞太航空業 看重本地備料與長約
zh.summary: 泰雷茲以新加坡、北京及新德里據點支援亞太機隊，並以與越捷航空的維修合約為例，說明如何透過在地備料縮短等待時間。
body: 泰雷茲（Thales）航空全球服務主管 Thomas Got 在新加坡舉行的 MRO Asia-Pacific 展會受訪時表示，公司以新加坡為亞太營運中心，並在北京及新德里設有據點。據 AeroTime 11月19日刊出的訪談，新德里據點於2025年啟用，部分維修工作也會交由泰雷茲其他地區的中心處理。
Got 指出，備件能否及時交付會影響航空公司排班。泰雷茲的部分合約由公司承諾維持指定設備庫存，與航空公司共同預測需求，讓部件能在區域內調度。
越捷航空今年9月已公布與泰雷茲簽訂按飛行時數計費的維修合約，涵蓋空中巴士 A320 系列與 A330 系列的航電設備。Got 表示，公司希望將這類長期支援模式擴展至其他亞太航空公司。

en.title: Thales outlines three-hub strategy for Asia-Pacific airline maintenance
en.summary: Thales is using sites in Singapore, Beijing and New Delhi to support Asia-Pacific airlines, with local stocks and long-term contracts aimed at cutting waits for parts.
body: Thales aviation services chief Thomas Got told AeroTime at MRO Asia-Pacific in Singapore that the company supports the region from sites in Singapore, Beijing and New Delhi. The New Delhi facility opened in 2025. Some work goes to other repair centers in Thales’s global network.

In the interview published November 19, Got said component availability affects airline schedules. Under some contracts, Thales holds stock for designated equipment and forecasts demand with airline customers so parts can be sourced locally.

Vietjet announced in September that it had signed a repair-by-the-hour agreement with Thales covering avionics on its Airbus A320 and A330 families. Got said Thales aims to extend this type of long-term support to other Asia-Pacific airlines.
